text: Planning a trip is often as exciting as the journey itself. I spent weeks researching flights, booking hostels, and creating a list of must-see sights. When I finally arrived in Vietnam, everything felt new and vibrant. The food was incredible; I loved the fresh herbs in every bowl of pho, though I was less brave with the spicy street snacks. The language barrier was tricky at times, but using a translation app and pointing at menus helped me connect with locals who were surprisingly patient. Those small, unplanned moments—sharing a laugh with a market seller or getting lost in a rainy alley—became my most treasured memories.
